exams.name: Uniform Certified Public Accountant Examination
exams.notes: May be conducted by the board or by a public or private organization specified by the board under a uniform examination system.
exams.jurisdiction: national (conducted under a uniform examination system by a public or private organization specified by the board)
exams.quote: An applicant for a certified public accountant license shall have successfully passed an examination in subjects the board deems appropriate, and in the form and manner that the board deems appropriate.

interval_years.quote: A permit issued under this chapter to a certified public accountant or a public accountant expires at 12 midnight on the last day of the month of the legal birthday of the licensee during the second year of a two-year term if not renewed.

renewal_fee_usd.quote: The biennial renewal fee for a certified public accountant to engage in the practice of public accountancy, as specified in Section 5070, shall be three hundred forty dollars ($340) for permits expiring after June 30, 2024.

required.quote: The Legislature has determined it is in the public interest to require that certified public accountants and public accountants licensed under provisions of this chapter comply with continuing education requirements adopted by the board as a prerequisite to the renewal of public accountancy licenses

period_years.quote: A licensee who plans, directs, or approves any financial or compliance audit report on any governmental agency shall complete a minimum of 24 hours of qualifying continuing education in the area of governmental accounting and auditing or related subjects during the two-year license renewal period.

value: 24 hours in governmental accounting and auditing for licensees who plan, direct, or approve financial or compliance audit reports on governmental agencies (per two-year renewal period)

24 hours in accounting and auditing related to reporting on financial statements for licensees who provide audit, review, other attestation services, or issue compiled financial statement reports (per two-year renewal period)

topical_requirements.quote: A licensee who plans, directs, or approves any financial or compliance audit report on any governmental agency shall complete a minimum of 24 hours of qualifying continuing education in the area of governmental accounting and auditing or related subjects during the two-year license renewal period.

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a current, active, and unrestricted CPA license from another state with standards substantially equivalent to California's standards of education, examination, and experience. Out-of-state CPAs may also practice under a practice privilege without obtaining a CA license if their principal place of business is not in California.

title_protection.quote: No other person, except a firm registered under this chapter, shall assume or use that title, designation, or abbreviation or any other title, designation, sign, card, or device tending to indicate that the person using it is a certified public accountant.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of any crime substantially related to the qualifications, functions and duties of a CPA or public accountant.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of any crime substantially related to the qualifications, functions and duties of a certified public accountant or a public accountant.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of sections dealing with false statements or omissions in applications for a license, certificate, registration, or permit.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A violation of Section 478, 498, or 499 dealing with false statements or omissions in the application for a license, in obtaining a certificate as a certified public accountant, in obtaining registration under this chapter, or in obtaining a permit to practice public accountancy under this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dishonesty, fraud, gross negligence, or repeated negligent acts resulting in violations of applicable professional standards indicating lack of competency.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dishonesty, fraud, gross negligence, or repeated negligent acts committed in the same or different engagements, for the same or different clients, or any combination of engagements or clients, each resulting in a violation of applicable professional standards that indicate a lack of competency in the practice of public accountancy

disciplinary_grounds.description: Cancellation, revocation, or suspension of certificate or authority to practice in another state or foreign country, or refusal to renew.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Cancellation, revocation, or suspension of a certificate or other authority to practice as a certified public accountant or a public accountant, refusal to renew the certificate or other authority to practice as a certified public accountant or a public accountant, or any other discipline by any other state or foreign country.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of Section 5097 relating to audit documentation requirements.
Violation of Section 5120 relating to unlicensed practice prohibitions.
Willful violation of this chapter or any rule or regulation promulgated by the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful violation of this chapter or any rule or regulation promulgated by the board under the authority granted under this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Suspension or revocation of the right to practice before any governmental body or agency.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Suspension or revocation of the right to practice before any governmental body or agency.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fiscal dishonesty or breach of fiduciary responsibility of any kind.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fiscal dishonesty or breach of fiduciary responsibility of any kind.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowing preparation, publication, or dissemination of false, fraudulent, or materially misleading financial statements, reports, or information.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowing preparation, publication, or dissemination of false, fraudulent, or materially misleading financial statements, reports, or information.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Embezzlement, theft, misappropriation of funds or property, or obtaining money or property by fraudulent means.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Embezzlement, theft, misappropriation of funds or property, or obtaining money, property, or other valuable consideration by fraudulent means or false pretenses.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Imposition of discipline, penalty, or sanction by the PCAOB or SEC under Sarbanes-Oxley or other federal legislation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The imposition of any discipline, penalty, or sanction on a registered public accounting firm or any associated person of such firm, or both, or on any other holder of a permit, certificate, license, or other authority to practice in this state, by the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board or the United States Securities and Exchange Commission

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unlawfully engaging in the practice of public accountancy in another state.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unlawfully engaging in the practice of public accountancy in another state.

definition_quote.value: a person shall be deemed to be engaged in the practice of public accountancy within the meaning and intent of this chapter if they do any of the following: (a) Hold themselves out to the public in any manner as one skilled in the knowledge, science, and practice of accounting, and as qualified and ready to render professional service as a public accountant for compensation. (b) Maintain an office for the transaction of business as a public accountant. (c) Offer to prospective clients to perform for compensation, or does perform on behalf of clients for compensation, professional services that involve or require an audit, examination, verification, investigation, certification, presentation, or review of financial transactions and accounting records.
definition_quote.quote: a person shall be deemed to be engaged in the practice of public accountancy within the meaning and intent of this chapter if they do any of the following: (a) Hold themselves out to the public in any manner as one skilled in the knowledge, science, and practice of accounting, and as qualified and ready to render professional service as a public accountant for compensation.

review of a financial statement

attest_services_types.quote: An audit or review of a financial statement for an entity headquartered in California. A compilation of a financial statement when that person expects, or reasonably might expect, that a third party will use the financial statement and the compilation report does not disclose a lack of independence for an entity headquartered in California. An examination of prospective financial information for an entity headquartered in California.

compilation_services_authorized.quote: A compilation of a financial statement when that person expects, or reasonably might expect, that a third party will use the financial statement and the compilation report does not disclose a lack of independence for an entity headquartered in California.

education_semester_hours_required.quote: An applicant for issuance of the certified public accountant license under this section shall present satisfactory evidence that the applicant has completed at least 150 semester units of college education

practice_privilege_no_notice_required.quote: An individual who qualifies for the practice privilege under this section may engage in the practice of public accountancy in this state, and a notice, fee, or other requirement shall not be imposed on that individual by the board.

value: Subject to personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the board and courts of this state
Shall comply with provisions of this chapter, board regulations, and other laws, regulations, and professional standards applicable to the practice of public accountancy
Shall not provide public accountancy services in this state from any office located in this state, except as an employee of a firm registered in this state
Deemed to have appointed the regulatory agency of the state that issued the individual's certificate, license, or permit as agent for service of process
Shall cooperate with any board investigation or inquiry
Shall cease exercising the practice privilege if home-state disciplinary action arises from gross negligence, fraud, or false financial statements
Shall cease exercising the practice privilege if convicted of any crime involving dishonesty
Shall cease exercising the practice privilege if barred by SEC or PCAOB
Shall cease exercising the practice privilege if any governmental body or agency suspends the right to practice before them
Shall report pending criminal charges within 30 days
practice_privilege_consent_conditions.quote: An individual who holds a practice privilege under this article, and is exercising the practice privilege in California: (1) Is subject to the personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the board and the courts of this state.

attest_services_require_firm_permit.quote: An individual who qualifies for the practice privilege under this section may perform the following services only through a firm of certified public accountants that has obtained a registration from the board pursuant to Section 5096.12

firm_majority_cpa_ownership_required.quote: Licensees shall in the aggregate, directly or beneficially, hold more than half of the equity capital and possess majority voting rights.

nonlicensee_firm_owners_permitted.quote: Notwithstanding any other provision of this chapter, any firm lawfully engaged in the practice of public accountancy in this state may have owners who are not licensed as certified public accountants or public accountants if the following conditions are met

peer_review_required_for_firm_renewal.quote: In order to renew its registration in an active status or convert to an active status, a firm, as defined in Section 5035.1, shall have a peer review report of its accounting and auditing practice accepted by a board-recognized peer review program no less frequently than every three years.

peer_review_max_frequency_years.quote: shall have a peer review report of its accounting and auditing practice accepted by a board-recognized peer review program no less frequently than every three years.

peer_review_records_privileged.quote: Nothing in this section affects the discovery or admissibility of evidence in a civil or criminal action.

inactive_license_status_available.quote: The holder of an inactive license issued by the board pursuant to Section 462, when lawfully using the title "certified public accountant," the CPA designation

retired_license_status_available.quote: The board may establish, by regulation, a system for the placement of a license into a retired status, upon application, for certified public accountants and public accountants who are not actively engaged in the practice of public accountancy

out_of_state_firm_no_office_exemption.quote: A certified public accounting firm that is authorized to practice in another state and that does not have an office in this state may engage in the practice of public accountancy in this state through the holder of a practice privilege

office_supervision_by_licensed_cpa_requi.quote: In each office of a certified public accountant or public accountant in this state which is not under the personal management of such an accountant, respectively, work shall be supervised by a certified public accountant or public accountant.

attest_report_signer_competency_requirem.quote: To be authorized to sign reports on attest engagements, a licensee shall complete a minimum of 500 hours of experience, satisfactory to the board, in attest services.

client_confidentiality_privilege.quote: No confidential information obtained by a licensee, in their professional capacity, concerning a client or a prospective client shall be disclosed by the licensee without the written permission of the client or prospective client

working_papers_ownership_by_licensee.quote: All statements, records, schedules, working papers and memoranda made by a licensee or a partner, shareholder, officer, director, or employee of a licensee, incident to, or in the course of, rendering services to a client in the practice of public accountancy, except the reports submitted by the licensee to the client and except for records that are part of the client's records, shall be and remain the property of the licensee in the absence of an express agreement between the licensee and the client to the contrary.

commission_prohibition_during_attest.quote: A person engaged in the practice of public accountancy is prohibited from performing services for a client, or an officer or director of a client, or a client-sponsored retirement plan, for a commission or from receiving a commission from a third party for providing the products or services of that third party to a client

foreign_accountant_practice_exception.quote: Nothing in this chapter shall prohibit a person who holds a valid and current license, registration, certificate, permit, or other authority to practice public accountancy from a foreign country, and lawfully practicing therein, from temporarily engaging in the practice of public accountancy in this state incident to an engagement in that country

single_act_evidence_sufficient.quote: In any prosecution or hearing under this chapter, evidence of the commission of a single act prohibited by this chapter shall be sufficient to justify a conviction without evidence of a general course of conduct.

firm_permit_required_for_attest_services.quote: A firm that provides the services described in subdivision (c) of Section 5096 shall obtain a registration from the board.

accounting_practitioner_tier.quote: "Public accountant" means any person who has registered with the board as a public accountant and who holds a valid permit for the practice of public accountancy.

cpa_emeritus_or_retired_status_available.quote: The board may establish, by regulation, a system for the placement of a license into a retired status, upon application, for certified public accountants and public accountants who are not actively engaged in the practice of public accountancy

government_audit_cpe_requirement.quote: A licensee who plans, directs, or approves any financial or compliance audit report on any governmental agency shall complete a minimum of 24 hours of qualifying continuing education in the area of governmental accounting and auditing or related subjects during the two-year license renewal period.

client_records_return_obligation.quote: A licensee shall furnish to their client or former client, upon request and reasonable notice: (1) A copy of the licensee's working papers, to the extent that those working papers include records that would ordinarily constitute part of the client's records and are not otherwise available to the client.
